transient_storage.page_assumptions: A/B: all short pages reserved until stated lifetime; one full 16-page message per long VL. C: whole messages reserved for a declared 6ms page-residence budget+64 cycles, verified against captured EOF; this is resource-plan safety, not an official long completion limit.
transient_storage.app_assumptions: Reserve n+2 bytes from public first-valid until first GMII SOF+16; require first SOF within declared 200us case-planning budget.
transient_storage.return_guard_basis: Normal valid traffic has no rollback; page-return FIFO, ret_valid and free-ret1 pending retire long before 64 clocks after final GMII EOF (afdx_tx_builder.v:162-174,374-404; afdx_tx_free.v:48-56,113-133).
transient_storage.interpretation: Conservative scenario storage envelopes, not internal counter measurements or official latency formulae.

metadata.arrival_contract: One deterministic periodic stream per VL; no overlapping input slots; public first valid is due+epoch+2.
metadata.timing_contract: Short public-first-valid to public-last-byte <=2ms; long completion raw and separate.
metadata.jitter_contract: Raw range by VL and payload. Internal <=50us and official <100us comparisons are separate; no unconditional BAG subtraction or negative clamping.

event_observability.captured: TX rejects, source app rejects/overflow, destination network errors and RM duplicate pulses
event_observability.not_captured: Destination ev_app overflow pin is not logged by the existing executable; any lost/truncated/corrupt output still fails exact delivery checking.

metadata.scope: Explicit normal network plan; no claim of arbitrary overload, bidirectional traffic, four-state X, or full-top VQM coverage.

binary_identity.transformation: UTF-8/newline normalization and finish_and_return(1) -> fatal(1) only

requirements.checker: one immutable configuration, epoch-relative 100ms window and every-VL recurrence
independent periodic schedule and complete source-byte delivery ledger
exact independent IPv4/UDP/offset/MF/ID/SN/FCS and A/B frame matrix, BAG and context occupancy
complete once-only delivery, zero abnormal events, exact redundancy count
public first-valid to last-byte, first-frame witnesses, raw and remaining-BAG statistics
